dedupe_keys.name: kazakhstan spatial electricity system input workbook

description: This workbook assembles spatial inputs for modelling the Kazakhstan electricity system. Researchers at Nazarbayev University and collaborating German institutions compiled literature and expert information into five sheets covering nodes, transmission lines, demand, generating plants and renewable availability. Demand includes hourly winter and summer weeks assigned to nodes, with import and export assumptions. Plant blocks carry technical and economic parameters. Coverage is national, but the compilation combines source years, not a uniform observation period; the article identifies 2013 for its nodal demand table. The published XLSX supplement is publicly accessible through Europe PMC. Access is free; the article states CC BY 4.0, while a separate supplementary-file licence was not established. This limitation is retained as an unknown file licence. Modellers could adapt the workbook for dispatch, market or capacity-expansion simulations. model-pypsa provides a related modelling environment without a verified importer. The named attachment returned successful metadata headers; no workbook cells or equations were inspected.
